QUICK TIPS
💡 Click any component ref in the PDF schematic to jump to it on the board
💡 Right-click a pad to highlight its entire net across the board
💡 Enable Diode Map first on any new board — red components = possible shorts
💡 Use FIND ▾ → FILTER BY STATE → UNMEASURED for systematic probing
💡 Double-click a tab name to rename it
💡 BOARD ▾ → EXPORT SESSION saves all your notes, measurements and annotations
SUGGEST A FEATURE

Have an idea that would make BoardScope better? We read every suggestion. The best ones get built into the next update.

POPULAR REQUESTS
⭐ Electron desktop installer (.exe / .dmg)
⭐ Auto-detect board model from filename
⭐ Community measurement sharing
⭐ SVG export of board view
REPORT A BUG

Found something broken? Tell us what happened and we'll fix it fast.
